deep_dive_report.report_title: Deep Dive OON Analysis - Commercial Local Group (MCM006) - R3 Period (Feb 2026 - Apr 2026)

detail_statements: Out of 63,580 total claims, NPAR claims count percentage increased by 2.39% and PMPM ratio increased by 0.58% for R3 period.
In CA, out of 63,580 total claims (for R3), 61,923 (97.39%) were NPAR, resulting in $33,624,521.66 in OON payments.

In CA, out of 36 total NPAR claims for SUTTER ROSEVILLE MEDICAL CENTER under the HMO product, 97.22% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In CA, IDR claims represented 11.69% of total OON claims, indicating an upward trend in dispute activity relative to overall OON volume.
In CA, out of 61,923 total NPAR claims, 7,237 (11.69%) were flagged for IDR, representing a 45.86% increase from the prior period.
Among the 7,237 IDR-flagged claims, the top providers are HEALTHQUEST ESOTERICS, WACO TEXAS EMERGENCY CENTER LLC, MONARCH DIAGNOSTICS.
No PAR/NPAR same-product overlap was identified for the top IDR providers in CA, suggesting these providers are primarily out-of-network without corresponding in-network claims for the same products.
Out of 25,566 total claims, NPAR claims count percentage increased by 4.89% and PMPM ratio increased by -31.29% for R3 period.
In NY, out of 25,566 total claims (for R3), 24,839 (97.16%) were NPAR, resulting in $3,311,351.47 in OON payments.

In NY, out of 91 total NPAR claims for MOUNT SINAI BETH ISRAEL PETRIE under the PPO product, 62.50% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In NY, IDR claims represented 2.47% of total OON claims, indicating an upward trend in dispute activity relative to overall OON volume.
In NY, out of 24,839 total NPAR claims, 614 (2.47%) were flagged for IDR, representing a 56.94% increase from the prior period.
Among the 614 IDR-flagged claims, the top providers are MEMORIAL REGIONAL HOSPITAL, BROWARD HEALTH CORAL SPRINGS, BROWARD HEALTH MEDICAL CENTER.
No PAR/NPAR same-product overlap was identified for the top IDR providers in NY, suggesting these providers are primarily out-of-network without corresponding in-network claims for the same products.
Out of 6,474 total claims, NPAR claims count percentage increased by -14.25% and PMPM ratio increased by -42.37% for R3 period.
In VA, out of 6,474 total claims (for R3), 6,413 (99.06%) were NPAR, resulting in $1,077,745.09 in OON payments.

In VA, out of 14 total NPAR claims for LAB CORP under the PPO product, 100.00% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In VA, IDR claims represented 3.18% of total OON claims, indicating an upward trend in dispute activity relative to overall OON volume.
In VA, out of 6,413 total NPAR claims, 204 (3.18%) were flagged for IDR, representing a 60.75% increase from the prior period.
Among the 204 IDR-flagged claims, the top providers are UCI MEDICAL CENTER, GARDEN GROVE HOSPITAL AND MEDICAL CENTER, RESTON HOSPITAL CENTER.
No PAR/NPAR same-product overlap was identified for the top IDR providers in VA, suggesting these providers are primarily out-of-network without corresponding in-network claims for the same products.

UCI MEDICAL CENTER shows a recurring PAR/OON reimbursement overlap for the same provider and facility service types, indicating inconsistent network assignment and potential provider configuration gaps.

DRG 885 (Psychoses) and DRG 807 (Vaginal Delivery without Sterilization or D&C without CC/MCC) are the top contributing DRGs for OON reimbursements for UCI MEDICAL CENTER, with claims highly dispersed across 27 DRGs.

metrics.metric_label: NPAR volume and spend impact - Facility
detail_statements: During the same R3 period, NPAR claim volume increased by 2,629 claims and associated paid amounts increased by $5,340,443.42 for UCI MEDICAL CENTER, indicating higher NPAR utilization and an elevated PMPM impact (NPAR spend per member month) relative to the baseline.

EXAGEN shows a recurring PAR/OON reimbursement overlap for similar member populations and professional service types, indicating inconsistent network assignment and potential provider configuration gaps.
All DRG classifications for EXAGEN are NOT_MAPPED, preventing granular DRG-level analysis for professional claims.
Out of total OON claims for BILL H BOSHELL, IDR claims represented 100.00%, indicating significant dispute activity relative to overall OON volume.
All DRG classifications for BILL H BOSHELL are NOT_MAPPED, preventing DRG-level concentration analysis.
Additionally, BILL H BOSHELL has 100.00% PAR claims for the past 12 months under PAR_MATCH_SAME_PRODUCT, indicating potential network and/or configuration issues.
